svg.title: Forward and reverse diffusion
svg.desc: Five panels show an image at timesteps 0, 250, 500, 750 and T. Moving right, the fixed forward process adds Gaussian noise until only noise remains. Moving left, the learned reverse process predicts the noise in each state and steps back toward a clean image. Any x_t can be sampled directly from x_0 in one step.
svg.text: Forward process destroys, reverse process rebuilds
Forward q: add a little Gaussian noise each step (fixed, no learning)
Reverse p_θ: the network predicts the noise ε in x_t and steps back toward x_{t−1} (learned)
Jump to any step directly: x_t = √ᾱ_t · x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ_t) · ε, ε ~ N(0, I)
Training loss: mse(model(x_t, t), ε) at a random timestep t
